text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm,
I came so close, though...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Guess my heart just wasn't in it enough, huh?
If only I could've pushed through one last time—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...No, regretting it won't change the fact that a loss is a loss.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All we can do is accept the results for what they are
and prepare for what comes next.
choice_data_list: There are things you can learn from failure.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that
really encourages me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: All right, in that case, let's get right into training for the next one.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Of course I understand that.
It's not like I mean we shouldn't look back at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't fret over it.
That is all I wished to say.
